page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.re6 family. It is powered by Intel Xeon 8269CL processors, delivering 208 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core. The instance runs on a KVM hypervisor and is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 14.77 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of memory relative to the dedicated CPU cores allows organizations to consolidate massive in-memory databases and large-scale analytical workloads onto a single node, minimizing the network overhead and management complexity associated with multi-node clusters.

The ecs.re6.52xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, massive data caching layers, and heavy memory-bound data processing tasks that require substantial RAM capacity without the need for local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
